extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath automation configuration panel for an action set to “Start and wait for RPA workflow.” The selected automation is “Process Benefits Application,” and the input argument “In_Application” is mapped to the variable “in_Application.” The Outputs section is expanded, showing mapped outputs such as Error, MonthlyIncome, Address, Name, HouseholdSize, and Zipcode.
extraction.step_instructions:
Click on the Automation field and select “Process Benefits Application.”
In the Inputs section, click the In_Application field and select or enter the variable “in_Application.”
Verify that the output fields are mapped to the corresponding variables shown, such as Error, MonthlyIncome, Address, Name, HouseholdSize, and Zipcode.
